q_hi:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined word segment in the given sentence.

He was attracted by the agenda of that party and became a member, it is well said, persons of the same character generally associate together.

Choose the option which best replaces the underlined text.

The poet’s work was admired for its brief and striking expressions containing general truths that resonated with readers.

Select the most suitable option to complete the sentence:

Nitin completed the intricate design __________, showcasing both skill and patience.

Select the most appropriate article to fill in the blanks. If no article is required, select ‘No article required’.

The proposal lacked _____ clear structure, which made it hard to evaluate.
solution:
• Indefinite article 'a' is used before singular countable nouns starting with a consonant sound. अनिर्दिष्ट 'a' एकवचन गणनीय संज्ञाओं से पहले आता है जो व्यंजन ध्वनि से शुरू होती हैं।

  • "clear structure" is a singular countable noun phrase with a consonant sound. Option 2 (a) fits. "clear structure" एक एकवचन गणनीय संज्ञा वाक्यांश है जिसकी व्यंजन ध्वनि है। विकल्प 2 (a) सही है।

Select the option that is the most appropriate antonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

The obsolete technology was finally replaced, which eventually led to an increase in production values.

Choose the correct conjunction to complete the sentence.

I wanted to go for a walk, ______ it started raining.
solution:
• Conjunction 'but' shows contrast or opposition between two ideas. संयोजक 'but' दो विचारों के बीच विरोध या विपरीतता दर्शाता है.

  • Here, 'wanted to walk' is contrasted with 'it started raining'. Option 1 fits. यहाँ, 'चलने की इच्छा' का 'बारिश शुरू होने' से विरोध है। विकल्प 1 सही.

The director decided to ignore the minor issues and focus on the main problem.

Comprehension:
Read the given passage and answer the following questions.

Wildlife conservation efforts have increasingly turned toward community-based strategies. Traditionally, conservation was handled by government agencies and scientists who focused mainly on protecting endangered species and preserving natural habitats. While these efforts achieved partial success, they often overlooked the involvement of local communities who share their landscapes with wildlife. In recent years, conservationists have recognized that sustainable outcomes require active participation from the people living closest to forests, rivers, and grasslands. Communities help monitor species, report threats, and adopt eco-friendly livelihood practices such as responsible tourism, organic farming, and reduced hunting. These activities ensure that conservation does not remain a top-down approach but becomes an inclusive partnership. However, challenges remain: some communities depend on forest resources for survival, making strict protective measures difficult. Successful conservation therefore requires balancing ecological goals with social realities. When communities receive training, incentives, and respect for their traditional knowledge, conservation efforts become more effective and long-lasting.
What is the tone of the passage?
